description: Set metadata on a conversation. Use this to store custom state, tags, or context that persists between messages. Pass null to clear metadata.

conversation_id.description: The ID of the conversation to update, from list_conversations.

metadata.description: A JSON object of custom state to store on the conversation (tags, context, and so on), or null to clear what's stored.

name: update_conversation

outputSchema.description: The conversation after its metadata was updated.

agentId.description: ID of the agent on this thread, or null.

id.description: The conversation's unique ID (use as conversation_id).

lastMessageAt.description: Time of the most recent message (ISO 8601), or null.

lastMessagePreview.description: Short preview of the latest message.

metadata.description: Custom state stored on the conversation, or null.

participant.description: The external contact's number in E.164 format.

phoneNumberId.description: ID of your phone number in this thread.

title: Update Conversation
